title: Bayesian Active Learning by Disagreements: A Geometric Perspective
label: explanation_only

paper_experiments.name: Uninformative Prior Acquisition Experiment
paper_experiments.description: Experiment comparing GBALD and BALD when initial labeled dataset D_0 is initialized from single or unbalanced classes.

paper_experiments.name: Ranked Informative Acquisition Experiment
paper_experiments.description: Experiment evaluating GBALD candidate pool ranking (b in {3,5,7}, b'=1) versus standard BALD to measure reduction in redundant sampling.

paper_experiments.name: Active Acquisition Benchmark Evaluation
paper_experiments.description: Evaluation of GBALD against standard active learning methods (Var, BALD, Entropy, k-medoids, k-centers) on MNIST, SVHN, and CIFAR-10 datasets.

paper_settings_described.name: Geometric Internal Radius R0
paper_settings_described.description: Radius parameter for internal spheres in geometric probability model p(y_i|x_i, theta); default R0 = 2000.0.

paper_settings_described.name: Ellipsoid Affine Factor Eta
paper_settings_described.description: Contraction factor eta in (0, 1) controlling the rescaling of spherical candidate points onto the ellipsoid surface; default eta = 0.9.

paper_settings_described.name: Initial Core-set Size N_M
paper_settings_described.description: Number of initial core-set samples constructed geometrically in Stage 1 before starting active model uncertainty acquisitions.

paper_settings_described.name: Batch Candidates Pool Size b
paper_settings_described.description: Number of top model-uncertainty candidate samples extracted via MC dropout in each active acquisition iteration.

paper_settings_described.name: Batch Output Size b'
paper_settings_described.description: Number of highly representative samples selected from candidate pool b to be added to the labeled set in each iteration.

paper_settings_described.name: Active Acquisition Iteration Budget A
paper_settings_described.description: Total number of active acquisition loop iterations in Stage 2, calculated as A = (Q - N_M) / b'.
